prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2025-12-18, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2025-12-18):
Fiscal period 2025 Q4 (filed 2025-12-18). Revenue 18,015M, gross margin 68%, operating income 7,508M (operating margin 42%), net income 8,518M, diluted EPS 1.74. Total assets 171,092M, total liabilities 89,800M, shareholders' equity 81,292M. Current assets 31,573M vs current liabilities 18,514M (current ratio 1.71), retained earnings 9,761M.
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The reported financials reflect exceptional profitability (42% operating margin), ample liquidity (current ratio >1.7), and a conservatively leveraged balance sheet (equity > liabilities with no obvious distress signals), all consistent with minimal default risk.
DECISION: AAA
